2.198.18
RadialScale.ScaleLabels
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The RadialScale.ScaleLabels element specifies labels to display on a RadialScale. This element is
optional. This element is of type ScaleLabels.
The following is the parent element of the RadialScale.ScaleLabels element.
Parent elements
RadialScale
The following is the XML Schema definition of the RadialScale.ScaleLabels element.
 <xsd:element name="ScaleLabels" type="ScaleLabelsType" minOccurs="0" />
